const shapeMap={clock:['round','square'],mirror:['round','square','rectangular','oval'],carpet:['round','square','rectangular','oval'],table:['round','square','rectangular','oval'],window:['square','rectangular'],door:['rectangular'],television:['rectangular']};
const catNames=['House furniture','Size','Colour','Shape'];const css=['blue','yellow','green','pink'];
const data=[nouns.map((word,i)=>({word,obj:word,visualColour:['blue','pink','brown','purple','yellow','green','purple','green','blue','pink','yellow','purple'][i],visualShape:word==='clock'?'round':word==='mirror'?'oval':''})),['big','small'].map(word=>({word,obj:'sofa',size:word})),Object.keys(colours).map((word,i)=>({word,obj:['chair','sofa','door','lamp','table','bed','cupboard','carpet'][i],colour:word})),['round','square','rectangular','oval'].map((word,i)=>({word,obj:['clock','window','carpet','mirror'][i],shape:word}))];
let progress=[[],[],[],[]];try{progress=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('houseWordsExplored'))||progress;if(!Array.isArray(progress)||progress.length!==4)progress=[[],[],[],[]]}catch(e){}
let category=0,item=0,view='home',quiz=0,step=0,watch=0,chosen={obj:'table',size:'big',shape:'round',colour:'brown'},placed=[],selected=null,hintIndex=-1,voices=[],audioMessage='Tap a Listen button, then say it aloud.';
const app=document.getElementById('app');
let artId=0;function svg(obj,colour='blue',shape='',size='',label=''){const base=colours[colour]||colour;const uid='toy'+(++artId);const c='url(#'+uid+')';const outline='#30495d';let x='';const r=(a,b,w,h,fill=c,rad=13)=>`<rect x="${a}" y="${b}" width="${w}" height="${h}" rx="${rad}" fill="${fill}"/>`;const line=(a,b,d,e)=>`<path d="M${a} ${b}L${d} ${e}" fill="none"/>`;const el=(a,b,rx,ry,fill=c)=>`<ellipse cx="${a}" cy="${b}" rx="${rx}" ry="${ry}" fill="${fill}"/>`;
const shapeBody=(fill=c)=>shape==='round'?el(120,91,57,57,fill):shape==='oval'?el(120,91,45,66,fill):shape==='square'?r(65,36,110,110,fill,3):r(39,48,162,90,fill,3);
switch(obj){case 'sofa':x=r(45,50,150,80)+r(30,85,180,57)+r(27,77,28,63)+r(185,77,28,63)+line(120,57,120,113)+line(55,115,185,115)+r(46,142,13,15,outline,2)+r(182,142,13,15,outline,2);break;case 'chair':x=r(75,28,90,78)+r(63,99,114,22)+line(77,122,70,165)+line(163,122,170,165)+line(100,43,100,85)+line(140,43,140,85);break;case 'table':x=line(64,98,56,160)+line(176,98,185,160)+line(111,112,111,160);x+=shape==='round'?el(120,78,70,36):shape==='oval'?el(120,78,93,30):r(shape==='square'?61:30,51,shape==='square'?118:180,56,c,3);break;case 'bed':x=r(30,43,180,101)+r(40,60,160,65,'#f7f3e9')+r(48,65,63,26,'#fff')+r(129,65,63,26,'#fff')+r(31,100,179,45)+r(30,130,180,24)+line(40,155,40,168)+line(200,155,200,168);break;case 'lamp':x=line(120,80,120,149)+el(120,152,43,10)+`<path d="M86 27H154L180 101H60Z" fill="${c}"/>`+line(159,102,159,122);break;case 'cupboard':x=r(53,20,134,139)+line(120,22,120,157)+el(108,92,3,3,outline)+el(132,92,3,3,outline)+line(65,159,65,169)+line(175,159,175,169);break;case 'television':x=r(29,36,182,109)+r(39,46,162,89,'#d8edf2',3)+line(83,146,70,163)+line(157,146,170,163)+`<path d="M58 114L103 65M85 117L130 68" opacity=".4" fill="none"/>`;break;case 'door':x=r(67,15,106,155,'#fff',2)+r(75,23,90,147,c,2)+r(88,37,62,57,c,2)+el(150,113,4,4,'#f5ce62');break;case 'window':x=shape==='rectangular'?r(43,35,154,115):r(60,25,120,120);x+=shape==='rectangular'?r(52,44,136,97,'#d9f0ff',1):r(69,34,102,102,'#d9f0ff',1);x+=line(120,36,120,140)+line(shape==='rectangular'?52:69,86,shape==='rectangular'?188:171,86);break;case 'mirror':x=shapeBody()+`<g transform="translate(120 91) scale(.83) translate(-120 -91)">${shapeBody('#dcf0f4')}</g><path d="M96 105L135 62M107 118L145 76" stroke="white" fill="none"/>`;break;case 'clock':x=shapeBody()+`<g fill="${outline}" stroke="none"><circle cx="120" cy="45" r="3"/><circle cx="120" cy="135" r="3"/><circle cx="76" cy="91" r="3"/><circle cx="164" cy="91" r="3"/></g>`+line(120,91,120,61)+line(120,91,144,103);break;case 'carpet':x=shapeBody()+`<g transform="translate(120 91) scale(.82) translate(-120 -91)" opacity=".5">${shapeBody()}</g>`;break;case 'shape':x=shapeBody();break;case 'house':x=`<path d="M55 79L120 23L185 79V163H55Z" fill="#fff7dc"/><path d="M38 82L120 12L202 82L188 95L120 38L52 95Z" fill="#e9a6a4"/>`+r(104,106,35,57,'#8ec2b4')+r(67,94,25,27,'#a7d2ec',3)+r(150,94,25,27,'#a7d2ec',3)+el(130,137,2,2,outline)+`<path d="M106 164L87 180H158L139 164" fill="#edd19d"/><circle cx="204" cy="30" r="17" fill="#f5d97a" stroke="none"/>`;break;}
return `<svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" role="img" aria-label="${label||[size,shape,colour,obj].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}"><defs><linearGradient id="${uid}" x1="0" y1="0" x2=".85" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="white"/><stop offset=".25" stop-color="${base}"/><stop offset=".75" stop-color="${base}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${base}" stop-opacity=".65"/></linearGradient><filter id="${uid}shadow" x="-25%" y="-25%" width="160%" height="170%"><feDropShadow dx="3" dy="6" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#49345f" flood-opacity=".25"/></filter></defs><ellipse cx="124" cy="175" rx="79" ry="9" fill="#70608720"/><g filter="url(#${uid}shadow)" stroke="#615777" stroke-opacity=".65" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" transform="translate(120 170) scale(${size==='small'?.58:size==='big'?1:.88}) translate(-120 -170)">${x}</g></svg>`}
function stop(){if('speechSynthesis'in window)speechSynthesis.cancel();document.querySelectorAll('.speaking').forEach(e=>e.classList.remove('speaking'))}
function loadVoices(){if('speechSynthesis'in window)voices=speechSynthesis.getVoices()};if('speechSynthesis'in window){loadVoices();speechSynthesis.addEventListener('voiceschanged',loadVoices)}
function say(text,slow=false){stop();if(!('speechSynthesis'in window)){audioMessage='Audio is not available in this browser. Please read aloud with your teacher.';status();return}loadVoices();let v=voices.find(v=>v.lang==='en-GB')||voices.find(v=>/^en[-_]/i.test(v.lang));const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);if(v)u.voice=v;u.lang=v?v.lang:'en-GB';u.rate=slow?.66:.88;audioMessage=v?`Voice: ${v.name} (${v.lang})`:'Using your device’s speech voice.';u.onerror=()=>{audioMessage='Audio could not play. Try Listen again or use another browser.';status()};u.onboundary=e=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-start]').forEach(n=>n.classList.toggle('speaking',e.charIndex>=+n.dataset.start&&e.charIndex<+n.dataset.start+n.textContent.length))};u.onend=()=>document.querySelectorAll('.speaking').forEach(n=>n.classList.remove('speaking'));speechSynthesis.speak(u);status()}
function status(){document.querySelectorAll('.audio-status').forEach(e=>e.textContent=audioMessage)}
function listen(text,label='Listen',slow=false){return `<button onclick='say(${JSON.stringify(text)},${slow})' aria-label='${label}: ${text}'>◖)) ${label}</button>`}
function tail(){return `<div class="audio-status" role="status">${audioMessage}</div><div class="footer"><span>MY NEW HOUSE · YEAR 3 ENGLISH</span><span>Look. Listen. Say. &nbsp; • &nbsp; Learning standard 2.1.5</span></div>`}
function nav(title){return `<div class="trail"><button onclick="home()">← Home</button><span>/ ${title}</span></div>`}
function mark(){if(!progress[category].includes(item)){progress[category].push(item);try{localStorage.setItem('houseWordsExplored',JSON.stringify(progress))}catch(e){}}}
function home(){stop();view='home';app.innerHTML=`<section class="hero"><div><span class="tag">YOUR LITTLE ENGLISH EXPLORER</span><h1>My House,<br>My <span style="color:#5f8d73">Words!</span></h1><p>Look, listen and say! Explore the things in a house and learn how to describe them.</p></div><div class="hero-art"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="A cute 3D cartoon house with a pink roof and a bunny reading a book" /></div></section><div class="section-head"><h2>Where shall we go?</h2><span class="muted">Choose a place to start ↓</span></div><div class="grid">${catNames.map((n,i)=>`<button class="category ${css[i]}" onclick="openCategory(${i})"><span class="number">${i+1}</span>${svg(['sofa','table','chair','mirror'][i],['blue','brown','green','pink'][i],i===3?'oval':'',i===1?'small':'')}<strong>${n}</strong><small>${progress[i].length}/${data[i].length} explored</small><span class="arrow">→</span><span class="card-face" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>`).join('')}</div><button class="build-banner" onclick="openBuilder()"><span><span class="badge">LET’S USE OUR WORDS</span><strong>Let’s build a sentence!</strong><span>Put our words together!</span></span><span class="build-icon" aria-hidden="true"><i>A</i><i>B</i><i>C</i></span><span style="font-size:32px">→</span></button>${tail()}`}
function openCategory(c){stop();category=c;view='grid';renderGrid()}
function renderGrid(){app.innerHTML=nav(catNames[category])+`<div class="section-head"><div><span class="tag ${css[category]}">LOOK, LISTEN AND SAY</span><h1>${catNames[category]}</h1><p>Tap a picture. Let’s learn a word!</p></div><span class="muted">${progress[category].length}/${data[category].length} explored</span></div><div class="vocab-grid">${data[category].map((d,i)=>`<button class="vocab ${css[category]}" onclick="detail(${i})">${progress[category].includes(i)?'<span class="seen">✓ Explored</span>':''}${category===1?`<div class="compare">${svg('sofa','blue','','big')}${svg('sofa','blue','','small')}</div>`:svg(d.obj,d.colour||d.visualColour||'blue',d.shape||d.visualShape||'',d.size||'')}${category===2?`<span class="swatch" style="background:${colours[d.word]}"></span>`:''}${category===3?`<span style="display:inline-block;width:55px;height:45px">${svg('shape','pink',d.shape)}</span>`:''}<strong>${d.word.toUpperCase()}</strong></button>`).join('')}</div>${category?practice():''}${tail()}`}
function phrase(d){let words=[d.size,d.shape,d.colour,d.obj].filter(Boolean).join(' ');return (/^oval/.test(words)?'an ':'a ')+words}
function detail(i){stop();item=i;mark();view='detail';let d=data[category][i],p=phrase(d),s='This is '+p+'.';app.innerHTML=nav(catNames[category])+`<button onclick="openCategory(category)">← Back to all ${category===0?'furniture':catNames[category].toLowerCase()+' words'}</button><div class="section-head"><span class="tag ${css[category]}">${catNames[category]}</span><span>${progress[category].length}/${data[category].length} explored</span></div><div class="panel detail"><div class="picture">${svg(d.obj,d.colour||d.visualColour||'blue',d.shape||d.visualShape||'',d.size||'',p)}${category===1?`<div class="compare">${svg('sofa','blue','','big')}${svg('sofa','blue','','small')}</div>`:''}${category===3?`<div style="width:100px">${svg('shape','pink',d.shape)}</div>`:''}</div><div><span class="muted">Listen and say the word!</span><h1>${d.word}</h1>${listen(d.word,'Hear the word')}${category?`<div class="audio-line"><span>${p}</span>${listen(p,'Hear phrase')}</div>`:''}<div class="audio-line"><strong>${s}</strong>${listen(s,'Hear sentence')}</div>${listen(s,'Hear it slowly',true)}<div class="controls"><button onclick="detail(item-1)" ${i===0?'disabled':''}>← Previous</button>${listen(d.word,'Listen Again')}<button onclick="detail(item+1)" ${i===data[category].length-1?'disabled':''}>Next →</button></div></div></div>${tail()}`;if(category===2)say(d.word)}
function practice(){const d=data[category][quiz%data[category].length];const instruction=category===1?`Tap the ${d.word} sofa.`:category===2?`Find ${d.word}.`:`Match ${d.word} to a household object.`;return `<section class="panel practice"><h2>${category===2?'Find the Colour':'Let’s try together'}</h2><div class="audio-line"><strong>${instruction}</strong>${listen(instruction,'Hear instruction')}</div>${category===3?`<button draggable="true" ondragstart="event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain','shape')" onclick="feedback('Now tap the matching object.')">${svg('shape','pink',d.shape)}${d.word} — drag or tap, then choose</button>`:''}<div class="choices">${data[category].map((a,i)=>`<button id="answer${i}" ondragover="event.preventDefault()" ondrop="event.preventDefault();checkAnswer(${i})" onclick="checkAnswer(${i})">${category===2?`<span class="swatch" style="background:${colours[a.word]}"></span><br>${a.word}`:svg(a.obj,a.colour||'blue',a.shape||'',a.size||'')}${category===3?a.obj:category===1?a.word:''}</button>`).join('')}</div><p id="feedback" class="feedback" role="status"></p><button onclick="quiz++;renderGrid()">Try another →</button></section>`}
function feedback(t){const e=document.getElementById('feedback');if(e)e.textContent=t}
function checkAnswer(i){let correct=quiz%data[category].length;if(i===correct){feedback('Well done! You found it.');say('Well done! You found it.')}else{feedback('Try again! Look at the outlined picture.');document.getElementById('answer'+correct).classList.add('hint');say('Try again!')}}
const models=['This is a table.','This is a big table.','This is a big round table.','This is a big round brown table.','This is a blue chair.','This is a big blue chair.','This is an oval mirror.'];
function words(){return ['size','shape','colour','obj'].filter(k=>chosen[k]).map(k=>({type:k,word:chosen[k]}))}function sentence(){return 'This is '+phrase(chosen)+'.'}function typeName(k){return k==='obj'?'object':k}function typeClass(k){return {size:'yellow',shape:'pink',colour:'green',obj:'blue'}[k]}
function openBuilder(){stop();step=0;watch=0;view='builder';renderBuilder()}
function goStep(n){stop();step=n;renderBuilder()}
function token(w,k,extra=''){return `<span class="word ${typeClass(k)} ${extra}"><small>${typeName(k)}</small>${w}</span>`}
function renderBuilder(){view='builder';let body='';if(step===0){let model=models[watch];body=`<div class="panel"><div class="detail"><div class="picture">${watch<4?svg('table','brown','round','big'):watch<6?svg('chair','blue','',watch===5?'big':''):svg('mirror','blue','oval')}</div><div><span class="tag">WATCH · ${watch+1}/7</span><h2>How do we build a sentence?</h2><p class="muted">Watch one word join the sentence.</p><h2>${model}</h2>${listen(model,'Hear sentence')}<div class="controls"><button onclick="watch--;renderBuilder()" ${watch===0?'disabled':''}>← Back</button><button onclick="watch++;renderBuilder()" ${watch===6?'disabled':''}>Next →</button></div></div></div><div class="strip"><span class="word"><small>starter</small>This is ${watch===6?'an':'a'}</span>${watch<4?`${watch>=1?token('big','size',watch===1?'highlight':''):''}${watch>=2?token('round','shape',watch===2?'highlight':''):''}${watch>=3?token('brown','colour','highlight'):''}${token('table','obj')}`:watch<6?`${watch===5?token('big','size','highlight'):''}${token('blue','colour')}${token('chair','obj')}`:`${token('oval','shape')}${token('mirror','obj')}`}<span class="word">.</span></div><p><strong>Size first, then shape, then colour. Say the object last!</strong><br><span class="muted">This is a + SIZE + SHAPE + COLOUR + OBJECT + full stop.</span><br>You do not need every describing word!</p><button class="primary" onclick="goStep(1)">Let’s build together →</button></div>`}
if(step===1){let ws=words();body=`<div class="builder-layout"><div class="panel"><span class="tag">CHOOSE YOUR WORDS</span><div class="group"><label for="object">OBJECT · What shall we describe?</label><select id="object" onchange="choose('obj',this.value)">${nouns.map(n=>`<option ${chosen.obj===n?'selected':''}>${n}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>${['size','shape','colour'].map(k=>{let options=k==='size'?['big','small']:k==='shape'?(shapeMap[chosen.obj]||[]):Object.keys(colours);return `<div class="group"><label>${k.toUpperCase()}${k==='shape'&&!options.length?' · No shape needed for this object':''}</label>${['',...options].map(v=>`<button class="${chosen[k]===v?'active':typeClass(k)}" onclick="choose('${k}','${v}')">${v||'Skip'}</button>`).join('')}</div>`}).join('')}</div><div class="picture">${svg(chosen.obj,chosen.colour||'blue',chosen.shape,chosen.size,phrase(chosen))}</div></div><section class="panel" style="margin-top:24px"><h2>Let’s put the words in order!</h2><p class="muted">Tap a word, then tap its space. You can drag words too.</p><div class="strip"><span class="word">This is ${/^oval/.test(ws.map(w=>w.word).join(' '))?'an':'a'}</span>${ws.map((w,i)=>`<button class="word slot ${typeClass(w.type)} ${hintIndex===i?'hint':''}" ondragover="event.preventDefault()" ondrop="event.preventDefault();put(+event.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain'),${i})" onclick="put(selected,${i})"><small>${typeName(w.type)}</small>${placed[i]!==undefined?ws[placed[i]].word:'···'}</button>`).join('')}<span class="word">.</span></div><div class="choices">${ws.map((w,i)=>({w,i})).reverse().filter(({i})=>!placed.includes(i)).map(({w,i})=>`<button class="word ${typeClass(w.type)} ${selected===i?'selected':''}" draggable="true" ondragstart="event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain','${i}')" onclick="selected=${i};renderBuilder()"><small>${typeName(w.type)}</small>${w.word}</button>`).join('')}</div><p id="feedback" class="feedback" role="status">${placed.filter(v=>v!==undefined).length===ws.length?'Well done! You built a sentence.':''}</p>${placed.filter(v=>v!==undefined).length===ws.length?`<h2>${sentence()}</h2>`:''}<div class="controls"><button onclick="showMe()">Show me</button><button onclick="hintIndex=words().findIndex((w,i)=>placed[i]===undefined);renderBuilder();feedback('Look at the outlined space. Match its category.')">Hint</button><button onclick="resetWords();renderBuilder()">Start again</button><button onclick="document.getElementById('object').focus();document.getElementById('object').scrollIntoView({block:'center'})">Choose another object</button><button class="primary" onclick="goStep(2)" ${placed.filter(v=>v!==undefined).length!==ws.length?'disabled':''}>Listen and say →</button></div></section>`}
if(step===2){let pos=0;body=`<div class="panel detail"><div class="picture">${svg(chosen.obj,chosen.colour||'blue',chosen.shape,chosen.size,phrase(chosen))}</div><div><span class="tag">YOUR SENTENCE</span><h2>Now say the sentence!</h2><h2>${sentence().split(' ').map(w=>{let start=pos;pos+=w.length+1;return `<span data-start="${start}">${w}</span>`}).join(' ')}</h2><p>Listen. Point to the words.<br>Now say the whole sentence!</p><div class="controls">${listen(sentence(),'Hear the sentence')}${listen(sentence(),'Hear it slowly',true)}${listen(sentence(),'Listen again')}</div><div class="controls"><button onclick="goStep(1)">← Back</button><button class="primary" onclick="resetWords();goStep(1)">Build another →</button></div></div></div>`}
app.innerHTML=nav('Let’s build a sentence!')+`<h1>Let’s build a sentence!</h1><div class="steps">${['1 · WATCH','2 · BUILD TOGETHER','3 · LISTEN AND SAY'].map((s,i)=>`<button class="${step===i?'active':''}" onclick="goStep(${i})" ${i===2&&placed.filter(v=>v!==undefined).length!==words().length?'disabled':''}>${s}</button>`).join('')}</div>`+body+tail()}
function resetWords(){placed=[];selected=null;hintIndex=-1}function choose(k,v){chosen[k]=v;if(k==='obj'&&!(shapeMap[v]||[]).includes(chosen.shape))chosen.shape='';resetWords();renderBuilder()}
function put(from,to){if(from===null||from===undefined||!Number.isInteger(from)||from<0||from>=words().length){feedback('Tap a word first, then tap its space.');return}if(from===to){placed[to]=from;selected=null;hintIndex=-1;renderBuilder();feedback(placed.filter(v=>v!==undefined).length===words().length?'Well done! You built a sentence.':`Great! The ${typeName(words()[to].type)} word belongs here.`)}else feedback('Try again! Size, then shape, then colour. Say the object last.')}
async function showMe(){resetWords();const total=words().length;for(let i=0;i<total;i++){if(view!=='builder'||step!==1)return;placed[i]=i;renderBuilder();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,280))}}
home();
</script></body></html>
